newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.076pts to 102.776.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.076pts to 102.776.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.076 points in Monday's trading to 102.776 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.848 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.141 points to 99.905, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.387 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 2.981 points to 1,048.327.
